claims.claim: The versioned bounded offline API requires independently supplied catalog/time authority, authenticates pinned Git records, and enforces exact admission bindings without caller-declared VALID authorization.
Lineage checks enforce contiguous ordinals, sealed content-digest links, distinct non-base descendant candidates, actual in-scope tree changes, and distinct transition source/target subjects.

The evaluator checks fixed Human/native delegation, lease identity and expiration at attested time, exact scope, finite reservations and monotonic accounting; uncertain or changed prerequisites fail closed.
Exact cataloged replay returns SAME_FACT; conflicting duplicates, incomplete tails and moved currentness stop without consuming feedback, resetting counters or writing artifacts.
Per-proof applicability delegates to published VP-03A, preserves immutable original observations and actual FAIL outcomes, and requires separate witnesses for every distinct target obligation.

Focused tests define disposable real-Git cases for ACTIVE/null-head admissions, lineage conflicts, replay/crash, accounting and lease drift, forged evidence, changed dependencies and distinct obligations, with read-only effect assertions.
The versioned document specifies trust-root limits, future Runtime durable CAS, terminal/REPAIR/REMEDIATION boundaries, all KA-01 gates and deferred verification obligations.

The committed candidate changes exactly the three permitted paths. The new module has no production integration or authoritative persistence and keeps all authorization, mutation, discharge and scheduler flags false.
